summary: All requirements have been implemented. The backend data structure was updated with new fields (lunarClimate, karmicLesson), all 27 Nakshatras were populated with the specified content via a migration module, the frontend banner displays the new fields, and the admin edit page includes form inputs for editing them.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend migration module (backend/migration.mo) was added to handle data migration from old to new Nakshatra structure
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not mention creating a migration system. It only specifies updating the data structure and populating the fields. The migration module appears to be an implementation detail that goes beyond the stated requirements.
